title: My house
instructions: Anna evini anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; sayılara ve odalara dikkat et.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Hello, my name is Anna. I live in a small town.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: My house is not very big, but I love it.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Downstairs, there is a kitchen and a living room.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: The kitchen is yellow. It is my favourite room.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: In the living room, there is a big sofa and a TV.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: Upstairs, there are three bedrooms and a bathroom.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: My bedroom is small. It has a bed, a desk and a window.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: From my window, I can see the park.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: We don't have a garage, but we have a nice garden.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: There are many flowers in the garden.

script.speaker: anna
script.text: My cat, Snow, sleeps in the garden every afternoon.

questions.feedback: Sarı mutfak (kitchen) en sevdiği oda. Kendi yatak odası küçük, onu en sevdiğim demiyor.
questions.evidence: The kitchen is yellow. It is my favourite room.

questions.feedback: Üst katta üç (three) yatak odası var. "Two" evin kat sayısı, çeldirici bu.
questions.evidence: Upstairs, there are three bedrooms and a bathroom.

questions.prompt: What can Anna see from her window?
questions.feedback: Penceresinden parkı (the park) görüyor. Bahçe evin bir parçası; garajları yok.
questions.evidence: From my window, I can see the park.
